consequence.statement: The first and last IP addresses of the IP pool are now available for allocation by default, changing the IP allocation behavior unless explicitly configured otherwise.
consequence.remediation: Explicitly set `allowFirstLastIPs: no` in your CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool configuration before the upgrade if you require the previous behavior of excluding first and last IP addresses.

original.statement: The default value of CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.allowFirstLastIPs changed from no to yes, making the first and last IP addresses of the pool available for allocation.

decision.reason: [ev-8aa9ac2ddd3a] says the default of `CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.allowFirstLastIPs` is now `yes`, so the first and last IP addresses of a pool can be allocated unless configured otherwise. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. Pools keep working; they just allocate addresses differently, which makes this a behavior-change (review). Setting `allowFirstLastIPs: no` is only advised "if you rely on the previous behavior", so it is a conditional fix, not a required migration. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence.
